calibration_review.coordinate_convention: Absolute source pixels; bbox right/bottom exclusive. root x follows the pelvis projection, root y follows the measured supporting sole. foot marks a supporting sole contact point rather than recentering the actor on that foot.
visual_observations: Eight source poses are present, but poses 1/4/5/8 repeat a broadly similar extended-stride silhouette; 2/6 and 3/7 are also close. A complete alternating walking cycle is not established by the source sheet alone.

Upper body, sword and free arm remain rather static; repeated coat-tail shapes and stance changes may read as pose substitutions rather than weight transfer. Real-speed playback and foot-sliding review remain required.

Silver hair with red forelock, black coat with red lining, double red forearm wraps, black trousers and segmented greaves are visible across the poses. Small buckle/strap details and exact weapon proportions still require comparison against standard_v1.

Weapon proportion needs review: a rough pose-1 guard [158,266] to tip [396,354] measurement gives approximately 104 output pixels at this shared body scale, versus the standard A7 guard-to-tip target of 128 pixels for a 190-pixel actor. This is an approximate visual measurement, not a validated weapon landmark contract.
